claims.text: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026 and made it available across its platforms and API that day.
Anthropic priced Opus 5 at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens and positioned it as the new default on Claude Max and the strongest model on Claude Pro.
Anthropic reports Opus 5 as close to Fable 5 frontier capability at lower cost and presents broad coding, knowledge-work, science, and safety evaluation gains.

limitations: Benchmark and alignment comparisons are primarily Anthropic-reported; individual evaluation harnesses and partner testimonials are not equivalent to independent replication.

DeepSeek states that the July 31 build keeps the architecture and size of V4-Flash-Preview and changes post-training only.

limitations: DeepSeek's benchmark scores for V4-Flash are vendor-reported and include a specified DeepSeek Harness configuration; this card treats the July lifecycle and API change as the primary fact.

overrides.why_this_special: Major July 16 open model release integrated directly into Kimi Code.

claims.text: Kimi Code's official changelog records Kimi K3 as released and open-sourced on July 16, 2026 and available in Kimi Code.
Moonshot describes Kimi K3 as a 2.8-trillion-parameter model using KDA hybrid linear attention and Attention Residuals, with native visual understanding and up to a 1M-token context window.
The same July 16 Kimi Code release aligned the coder sub-agent with background tasks, plan mode, skills, and nested-agent capabilities.

limitations: Architecture scale, capability comparisons, and benchmark positioning are vendor claims from the Kimi documentation; open-source status should be interpreted using the actual published license/weights when drafting.

overrides.why_this_special: Major July 31 multimodal generation model launch.

claims.text: MiniMax announced H3 at the end of July as a multimodal generative model intended to unify tasks across image, video, and audio generation and cross-modal context understanding.
MiniMax describes H3 as supporting up to 2K video output with native stereo sound and multimodal references spanning image, audio, and video.
At announcement time MiniMax said it planned to open the model weights in the coming days, so the launch itself must not be written as an already-completed open-weight release.

limitations: Generation quality and capability examples are vendor demonstrations; the announcement explicitly described weight publication as planned rather than complete at that moment.
